$comment: Supabase CLI commands that can reach production. Merged into the core guard when this stack is active. Every pattern has a test case in .claude/hooks/tests/guard-cases.json.

deny.reason: supabase db reset against a remote target drops every user-created object in that database, with no confirmation prompt. Only --local is safe.
supabase db reset without an explicit --local depends on hidden link state to decide its target. Pass --local so the target is visible in the command.

supabase db push applies migrations to the LINKED project, which is hidden CLI state rather than anything visible in the repo. Migrations reach production through the deployment pipeline, not from a developer machine.
Linking persists a production project reference locally, giving every subsequent db push a live target. The repo stays unlinked; CI links at run time with a credential that is not on this machine.
Reads directly from a remote database using linked credentials.
